(1) extra unit-speed machines can be used to obtain competitive results for flow time, stretch, and weighted flow time scheduling, (2) extra unit-speed machine results are as powerful as extra-speed machine results, and (3) extra unit-speed results are as powerful and as simple as extra-speed results.
